description: TUCSON - Congressman Juan Ciscomani has won re-election in Arizona’s 6th congressional district. See his full statement below. “Laura and I are deeply grateful to the people of Arizona’s 6th District, and honored by the trust they’ve placed in me to continue representing our community in Congress,”
title: Ciscomani Secures Re-Election Victory in Arizona’s 6th Congressional District — Juan Ciscomani for Congress
